steps.content:
Decap CMS is an open-source content manager for static sites. Content is stored as files in your Git repository, and every change you save becomes a commit.

The introduction covers installing the admin interface, choosing a backend (such as GitHub), and defining the collections and fields your editors will use.

It takes about ten minutes to read and links to deeper guides for each topic.
